info.title: Safaricom Daraja (M-Pesa) API
info.description: Safaricom's Daraja developer platform: OAuth, M-Pesa Express (STK push), C2B, B2C, B2B, Transaction Status, Account Balance, Reversals, Dynamic QR, Bill Manager, Pull Transactions, Ratiba standing orders and Safaricom's identity, IoT SIM, Bonga and data-bundle APIs, as documented on developer.safaricom.co.ke. Daraja publishes no machine spec and no global version; endpoints carry their own path versions (info.version is the capture date). The OpenFn mpesa adaptor gets a token from /oauth/v1/generate with the consumer key/secret and calls the M-Pesa paths with a Bearer token; its generic request() can reach any path here.

StandingOrderName.description: Name of standing order. Note that Standing Order (M-Pesa Ratiba) name must be unique for each customer. A customer can not create two Standing Orders with the same name.

StartDate.description: The date you wish for the standing order to start executing

EndDate.description: The date you wish for the standing order to stop executing

BusinessShortCode.description: The business short code to which the payment is to be sent

TransactionType.description: This is the transaction type that is used to identify the transaction when sending the request to M-PESA. Use Standing Order Pay Merchant External Third Party for buy goods till or Standing Order Pay Bill External Third Party for paybills.

ReceiverPartyIdentifierType.description: The ReceiverPartyIdentifierType is the code our systems uses to identify the short code in the request body. The value is "2" for a Merchant till (Till Number), and "4" for a Business Short Code (PayBill)

Amount.description: This is the amount transacted, normally a numeric value. Money that the customer pays to the Shortcode. Only whole numbers are supported. This will be deducted from user’s M-PESA balance each time the standing order executes.

PartyA.description: The phone number sending money.The parameter expected is a Valid Safaricom Mobile Number that is M-PESA registered in the format 2547XXXXXXXX

CallBackURL.description: A CallBack URL is a valid secure URL that is used to receive notifications from the Standing Order Solution. It is the endpoint to which the results will be sent.

AccountReference.description: Account Reference: This is a parameter that is defined by your system as an Identifier of the transaction for the StandingOrderCustomerPayBill transaction type (Account number usually given when making paybill payment). Maximum of 12 characters.

TransactionDesc.description: This is any additional information/comment that can be sent along with the request from your system. Maximum of 13 Characters

Frequency.description: This is a value representing the frequency at which you would like the transactions to happen. Valid values are: - 1-One Off, - 2-Daily, - 3-Weekly, - 4-Bi-weekly - 5-Monthly, - 6-Bi-monthly, - 7-Quarterly, - 8-Half Yearly, - 9-Yearly

MerchantRequestID.description: Global unique identifier for the transaction request returned by the API proxy upon successful request submission.

CheckoutRequestID.description: Global unique identifier for the transaction request returned by M-PESA upon successful request submission.

ResultCode.description: Numeric status code indicating the transaction processing status. 0 means success; any other code means error or failure.

ResultDesc.description: Message describing the status of the request processing. Maps to the ResultCode value.

Item.description: Array within CallbackMetadata holding additional transaction details as JSON objects. Only for successful transactions.

CallbackMetadata.description: JSON object holding more transaction details. Returned only for successful transactions.

stkCallback.description: First child of the Body, contains the callback details.

Body.description: Root key for the entire callback message.

StkCallback.description: Webhook payload POSTed to CallBackURL when an STK push completes (not returned by any endpoint).

stkCallback.ResultDesc: The service request is processed successfully.

BusinessShortCode.description: This is the organization's shortcode (Paybill or Buygoods - a 5 to 7-digit account number) used to identify an organization and receive the transaction.

Password.description: This is the password used for encrypting the request sent: a base64 encoded string. (The base64 string is a combination of Shortcode+Passkey+Timestamp).

Timestamp.description: This is the Timestamp of the transaction, normally in the format of YEAR+MONTH+DATE+HOUR+MINUTE+SECOND (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS). Each part should be at least two digits, apart from the year which takes four digits.

CheckoutRequestID.description: This is a global unique identifier of the processed checkout transaction request.

ResponseCode.description: This is a numeric status code that indicates the status of the transaction submission. 0 means successful submission and any other code means an error occurred.

ResponseDescription.description: Response description is an acknowledgment message from the API that gives the status of the request submission usually maps to a specific ResponseCode value. It can be a "Success" submission message or an error description.

ResultDesc.description: Result description is a message from the API that gives the status of the request processing, usually maps to a specific ResultCode value. It can be a success processing message or an error description message.
